published_tension_scenario.name: lofgren2005_wst150_mean
published_tension_scenario.source: references/papers/lofgren2005_wst/source.pdf, page 14, Figure 12 and Table 4, WST 150 Average row
published_tension_scenario.role: Conditional FRC tensile law for constitutive development, not a fit of Jansson material. The source mix uses 40 kg/m3 of 35 mm fibres; Jansson uses 53 kg/m3 HE 55/35 GL. The constitutive shape and this numerical scenario have distinct evidential roles.

coupon_demonstration.role: Uniaxial material-point and apparatus-control verification only. These dimensions do not describe a Jansson WST specimen or identify its fracture energy.

source_basis: https://doi.org/10.1016/0013-7944(90)90189-N, sections 2 and 4; original full text read online
